Fidelity is strong on every scalar parameter (q, N, 14-bit, 8 BUs, psi/omega/Ninv, Barrett mu/k all match) and on the round-trip/negacyclic/op-count claims, but weak on the paper's signature structural contribution: the specific conflict-free memory mapping is reconstructed, natural-order/no-bit-reversal is only functional, and all resource/timing/ATP claims are unverifiable in a functional model.

[control] Complete schedule/FSM state list and transition table
